header.name: hours_availability_dev
header.purpose: Development set for the boundary between service_question (opening hours, service area, what the business does) and availability_question (whether someone is free at a time). Written for D-085. None of these messages is copied from the tuned, held-out or sealed items. Not a result.

items.body: What time do you close on Saturdays?
Is your office open on Sundays? I might call in the morning.
What is the latest visit you can book on a Friday? I finish work at five.
Do you answer the phone after 6pm on weekdays?
When does the office open in the morning? I want to ring first thing.
Are you open on public holidays like Thanksgiving?
What are your hours over the Christmas week?
Hi, what time does the first appointment of the day usually start?
Do you work weekends at all, or is it Monday to Friday only?
What days of the week do your technicians do house calls?
Is the shop open Saturday afternoon or only the mornings?
Just checking your opening times for next week before I drive over with a part.
Until what time are you taking calls on Monday evenings?
Which hours is the front desk staffed? I need to drop off a form.
Is anyone free next Tuesday morning to look at a dripping kitchen tap?
Can someone come out on Thursday afternoon for a slow bathtub drain?
When is your next opening for a drain cleaning? Any time this week works.
Do you have anything available on the 14th for a water heater flush?
Are you able to fit us in this Saturday? Toilet keeps running.
Is there a slot open Monday morning for a leak check at our place in Wren Common?
What is the earliest you could send someone to replace a faucet?
Any chance of a visit tomorrow after 4? Garbage disposal is jammed.
How soon could you get a plumber to the house? Sink is backing up slowly.
Do you have a free appointment on Wednesday the 18th for a shower valve?
Are there openings next week for a sewer camera inspection?
I need a toilet looked at. Who is free on Friday?
Can I get a Saturday 9am slot or is that already taken?
Earliest date you have for a pipe repair in Tamarind Park please.
Is your Tuesday the 17th booked solid, or is there room for a quick faucet job?
Would someone be available between 1 and 3 on Thursday to quote a bathroom job?
Do you service the Saltmarsh area, and how far out do you go?
What kinds of plumbing work do you take on? Just repairs or full installs too?
Do you cover the Millrace neighbourhood?
